title: MarkDrift by UptoSolve: Free Video and Photo Watermark Tool
description: Free browser tools from UptoSolve. MarkDrift puts moving, tiled or corner watermarks on videos and photos. No upload, no sign-up, no logo of ours.
h1: MarkDrift: free watermark tool for videos and photos
lede: MarkDrift is a free, open-source (MIT) watermark tool by UptoSolve that adds moving, tiled or corner watermarks to videos and photos, one file or a whole batch, entirely in your browser with nothing uploaded.

title: Add a Watermark to Video Free: No Upload, No Sign-up
description: Put your name or logo on a video in your browser. Moving, tiled or corner styles, MP4 out. Nothing is uploaded, no account, no watermark of ours.
h1: Add a watermark to a video, free
lede: Type your name or pick your logo, drop in a video, and download an MP4 with your mark in every frame. It all runs in this tab, so your video never leaves your device.

title: Moving Watermark Maker: Animated Marks for Video, Free
description: Make a watermark that glides, bounces or jumps around your video, so a crop can't cut it out. Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.
lede: Your name or logo travels across the frame and bounces off the edges, so there's no corner to crop away. Watch the path in the preview, then download.

title: Batch Watermark Videos: Many Files at Once, Free
description: Add a whole shoot of Reels or TikToks, set one watermark, export them all. Vertical and landscape mixed. Free, no upload, saves to a folder in Chrome.
lede: Add every clip from the shoot, choose one set of settings, and press one button. Videos are made one after another and saved as each one finishes.

title: Watermark Photos Online Free: Batch, Tiled, No Upload
description: Add a tiled or corner watermark to JPG, PNG and WebP photos in your browser. Do one photo or a whole batch and get a ZIP back. Nothing is uploaded.
lede: Repeat your name or logo across every photo, or keep it to one corner. One photo comes straight back; a batch comes back as a single ZIP.

title: Add Logo to Video Online Free, With No Extra Watermark
description: Put your PNG or SVG logo on any video, in a corner or moving. Free in your browser, nothing uploaded, and the only logo on the file is yours.
h1: Add your logo to a video
lede: Choose your logo, pick a spot, and download a video whose only logo is yours. It can be turned white in one click.
